title: B2 dan C1 ga: ilg‘or daraja yo‘l xaritasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida C1 ning uchta asosiy talabini, B2 dagi besh bo‘shliqni va o‘z o‘quv rejangizni bilasiz hamda beshta o‘lchanadigan C1 maqsadini ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: C1 darajasiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum va tabriklayman! Oldingi darsda B2 imtihonini topshirdingiz, endi ilg‘or darajadasiz. Bugun yangi yo‘lning xaritasini chizamiz: C1 aslida nimani talab qiladi, B2 da odatda qaysi joylar bo‘sh qoladi, qanday o‘qish rejasi tuzish kerak va yutuqni qanday o‘lchash mumkin. Dars oxirida o‘z C1 maqsadlaringizni aniq ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Congratulations on reaching advanced level. Today we draw the map: what C1 really demands, where B2 learners fall short, and how to plan and measure your progress.
scenes.say_uz: Ilg‘or darajaga chiqqaningiz bilan tabriklayman. Bugun xarita chizamiz: C1 nimani talab qiladi, B2 da qayerda bo‘shliq bor, qanday reja tuzish va yutuqni qanday o‘lchash kerak.

scenes.title: C1 deskriptorlari: umumiy ko‘rinish
scenes.say_native: Umumevropa tizimiga ko‘ra C1 foydalanuvchisi murakkab, uzun matnlarni tushunadi va satr orasidagi ma’noni sezadi. U fikrini so‘z qidirmay, ravon va o‘z-o‘zidan ifodalaydi. Tilni ijtimoiy, akademik va kasbiy maqsadlarda moslashuvchan ishlatadi, murakkab mavzuda aniq, yaxshi tuzilgan matn yozadi. Biz bu uchta kalit so‘zni olamiz: aniqlik, moslashuvchanlik va yashirin ma’no.
scenes.say: At C1 you understand demanding texts and implied meaning, speak fluently without hunting for words, and use the language flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes.
scenes.say_uz: C1 da siz murakkab matnlarni va yashirin ma’noni tushunasiz, so‘z qidirmay ravon gapirasiz va tilni ijtimoiy, akademik, kasbiy maqsadlarda moslashuvchan ishlatasiz.

scenes.title: Birinchi kalit: aniqlik
board: Precision = the exact word + its partners

examples.t: The film was gripping from start to finish.
She was furious about the delay.

scenes.say_native: B2 da fikringizni tushuntira olasiz, C1 da esa uni aniq ifodalaysiz. Farq shundaki, “very good” o‘rniga vaziyatga mos bitta kuchli so‘z topasiz: film uchun “gripping”, natija uchun “outstanding”, ta’sir uchun “beneficial”. Aniqlik so‘zning sheriklarini, ya’ni birikmalarini ham bilishni anglatadi: “serious problem”, “heavy rain”. O‘zbek tilida “juda yaxshi” deyish mumkin, inglizchada esa bu zaif ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: Instead of very good, a C1 speaker reaches for the exact word: a gripping film, an outstanding result, a beneficial change.
scenes.say_uz: Very good o‘rniga C1 da aniq so‘z ishlatiladi: qiziqarli film, a’lo natija, foydali o‘zgarish.

scenes.title: Aniqlikdagi xatolar: zaif va noaniq so‘zlar
board: ✗ a big problem · a big rain
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato juda ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi — “very” ni takrorlash yoki uni har bir sifat oldiga qo‘yish. C1 da bunday emas, bitta kuchli sifat yetarli: “outstanding”, “exhausted”, “furious”. Ikkinchisi — birikmani so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilish. O‘zbekcha “katta yomg‘ir” deymiz, inglizchada esa “heavy rain”. Har bir yangi so‘zni sherigi bilan birga yodlang.
scenes.say: It was outstanding, not very very good. We say heavy rain, not big rain.
scenes.say_uz: Bu a’lo edi, juda juda yaxshi emas. Heavy rain deymiz, big rain emas.

scenes.title: Mashq: gapni aniqlashtiring
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta oddiy gapni C1 darajasiga ko‘taring. Har biri uchun bitta aniqroq so‘z yoki birikma toping. Birinchisi uchun film haqidagi kuchli sifat, ikkinchisi uchun “angry” dan kuchliroq so‘z, uchinchisi uchun “big” o‘rniga mosini, to‘rtinchisi uchun “talks a lot” ning boshqa ifodasini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Upgrade the four sentences. Replace the weak words with more precise ones.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni yaxshilang: zaif so‘zlarni aniqroq so‘zlar bilan almashtiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: aniqlik
board: 4. She is very talkative / talks non-stop.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “The film was gripping” yoki “outstanding”. Ikkinchi: “He was furious”, ya’ni “very angry” kuchli sifat bilan almashadi. Uchinchi: “It’s a serious problem” yoki “a major problem”. To‘rtinchi: “She is very talkative” yoki “She talks non-stop”. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, agar u aniq va tabiiy eshitilsa, to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: One: gripping. Two: furious. Three: a serious problem. Four: she is talkative, or she talks non-stop.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: gripping. Ikki: furious. Uch: serious problem. To‘rt: talkative yoki talks non-stop.

scenes.title: Aniq so‘z va uning sheriklari
board: raise a concern · draw attention to
meet a deadline · tackle a problem
scenes.say_native: Aniqlik uchun fe’l-ot birikmalarini ham biling. Inglizchada “progress” bilan “make” ishlatiladi, “conclusion” bilan “reach” yoki “draw”, “deadline” bilan “meet”, “problem” bilan “tackle”. Shu yerda o‘zbekcha so‘zma-so‘z tarjima yordam bermaydi: “muddatni bajarmoq” deymiz, inglizchada esa “meet a deadline”. Har kuni ikkita shunday birikmani gapingizda ishlatib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: We managed to meet the deadline, and we reached an agreement. Now we must tackle the real problem.
scenes.say_uz: Muddatga ulgurdik va kelishuvga erishdik. Endi asl muammoni hal qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi kalit: moslashuvchanlik
board: Informal: Can you sort this out?
Neutral: Could you deal with this?
Formal: I would be grateful if you could resolve this.

examples.t: I would be grateful if you could resolve this matter.
examples.uz: Bu masalani hal qilsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. (rasmiy)

scenes.say_native: Moslashuvchanlik — bitta fikrni vaziyatga qarab turli uslubda aytish. Do‘stingizga “Can you sort this out?” deysiz, hamkasbga “Could you deal with this?”, rasmiy xatda “I would be grateful if you could resolve this matter.” B2 da odatda bitta uslub bor, ko‘pincha neytral. C1 da esa tinglovchiga qarab, kerakli ohangni tanlaysiz. O‘zbek tilida “siz” va “sen” farqi shunga o‘xshaydi, inglizchada esa u butun gap tuzilishida namoyon bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The same request can be casual, neutral or formal. A flexible speaker chooses the register to suit the listener.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta iltimos norasmiy, neytral yoki rasmiy bo‘lishi mumkin. Moslashuvchan so‘zlovchi tinglovchiga qarab uslub tanlaydi.

scenes.title: Uslub nomuvofiqligi
board: ✗ Hi mate, I am writing to inform you ...
✓ Dear Ms Grant, I am writing to inform you ...
✗ We are gonna discuss the proposal. (report)
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p xato — uslubni aralashtirish. “Hi mate” bilan boshlab, keyin “I am writing to inform you” davom ettirish g‘alati eshitiladi. Rasmiy hisobotda “gonna”, “wanna” va qisqartmalar ishlatilmaydi, do‘stlar o‘rtasida esa haddan tashqari rasmiy gap sovuq tuyuladi. Yozishdan oldin o‘zingizga ikki savol bering: kimga yozyapman va nima uchun.
scenes.say: Keep one register from start to finish. Do not mix hi mate with I am writing to inform you.
scenes.say_uz: Boshidan oxirigacha bitta uslubni saqlang. Hi mate bilan I am writing to inform you ni aralashtirmang.

scenes.title: Mashq: rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing
board: Informal: We can't give you the money back because you didn't keep the receipt.
Make it formal: begin with Unfortunately, ...
scenes.say_native: Quyidagi norasmiy gapni rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing: “We can’t give you the money back because you didn’t keep the receipt.” Qisqartmalarni oching, “give the money back” o‘rniga rasmiyroq fe’l ishlating va “Unfortunately” bilan boshlang. Natija mijozga yoziladigan xatdan olingan gapdek eshitilsin.
scenes.say: Rewrite this sentence formally, beginning with Unfortunately.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gapni Unfortunately bilan boshlab, rasmiy uslubda qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Javob: rasmiy uslub
board: Unfortunately, we are unable to refund your money, as you did not retain the receipt.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: “Unfortunately, we are unable to refund your money, as you did not retain the receipt.” Nimalar o‘zgardi? “Can’t” o‘rniga “are unable to”, “give back” o‘rniga “refund”, “keep” o‘rniga “retain”, “because” o‘rniga “as”. Bu uchta o‘zgarish, ya’ni qisqartmani ochish, ko‘p so‘zli fe’l o‘rniga bitta rasmiy fe’l va rasmiy bog‘lovchi, rasmiy uslubning asosi.
scenes.say: Unfortunately, we are unable to refund your money, as you did not retain the receipt.
scenes.say_uz: Afsuski, kvitansiyani saqlamaganingiz uchun pulni qaytara olmaymiz.

scenes.title: Uchinchi kalit: yashirin ma’no
board: I'd have thought ... = I disagree, politely

examples.t: With respect, I see it differently.

scenes.say_native: Britaniya ingliz tilida ko‘p narsa to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytilmaydi. “Not bad” aslida “juda yaxshi” degani bo‘lishi mumkin, “That’s an interesting idea” esa ko‘pincha “ishonmayman” ma’nosini beradi. “I’d have thought...” va “With respect...” ibora ortida odatda e’tiroz yashiringan. O‘zbek tilida ham xushmuomalalik bor, lekin ingliz tilida bu ohang va tanlangan so‘zlar orqali beriladi. C1 da shuni eshitib, anglab olasiz.
scenes.say: In British English, much is implied. Interesting idea may mean I'm not convinced, and with respect usually introduces a disagreement.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniya inglizchasida ko‘p narsa yashiringan. Interesting idea ko‘pincha ishonmayman degani, with respect esa e’tirozdan oldin aytiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: ish yig‘ilishida
scenes.say_native: Mana birinchi tinglash matni. Ikki hamkasb yangi loyihani muhokama qilmoqda. Diqqat bilan eshiting: B ning so‘zlari xushmuomala, lekin uning haqiqiy fikri boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Raqam va sifatlarga emas, yumshatuvchi iboralarga quloq soling. Dialogdan keyin uchta savol beraman.
scenes.say: A: So, what do you make of the proposal? B: Well, it's certainly ambitious. I'd have thought the budget might be a little tight, though. A: Are you saying we shouldn't go ahead? B: I'm saying we might want to take another look at the figures before we commit.
scenes.say_uz: A: Taklif haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz? B: U, albatta, jasoratli. Lekin byudjet biroz tor bo‘lishi mumkin deb o‘ylagan bo‘lardim. A: Davom etmaylik demoqchimisiz? B: Majburiyat olishdan oldin raqamlarga yana bir qarash kerak, demoqchiman.

scenes.title: Mashq: B nima deb o‘ylaydi?
board: 1. Is certainly ambitious a pure compliment?
2. What does B think of the budget?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Bir: “It’s certainly ambitious” sof maqtovmi yoki ehtiyotkor ishoramikan? Ikki: B byudjet haqida aslida nima deb o‘ylaydi? Uch: B “yo‘q” deb aniq aytdimi? Javob berayotganda B ishlatgan yumshatuvchi ibora va “though” so‘ziga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Answer the three questions about what B really means.
scenes.say_uz: B aslida nimani nazarda tutayotgani haqidagi uchta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 2. B thinks the budget is too tight
3. No: B avoids a direct refusal
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “certainly ambitious” — bu ehtiyotkor ogohlantirish, chunki orqasidan “though” bilan e’tiroz keladi. Ikkinchi: B byudjetni yetarli emas deb hisoblaydi, “a little tight” yumshatilgan ibora. Uchinchi: yo‘q, B to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri rad etmaydi, balki “take another look at the figures” deydi. Bu aynan yashirin ma’no: so‘zlar mulohazali, fikr esa aniq.
scenes.say: B gives a polite warning, thinks the budget is too tight, and avoids a direct no. That is implied meaning.
scenes.say_uz: B xushmuomalalik bilan ogohlantiradi, byudjetni tor deb hisoblaydi va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yo‘q demaydi. Bu yashirin ma’no.

scenes.title: B2 dagi besh bo‘shliq
scenes.say_native: B2 da odatda besh joy bo‘sh qoladi. Birinchi: lug‘at doirasi, ayniqsa birikmalar va ma’no nozikliklari. Ikkinchi: grammatik murakkablik, masalan inversiya va ta’kidlovchi tuzilmalar, ularni keyingi darsda o‘rganamiz. Uchinchi: gaplarni bir-biriga bog‘lash. To‘rtinchi: shoshilganda xatolarning qaytishi. Beshinchi: tez va tabiiy nutqni, har xil aksentni tushunish.
scenes.say: Most B2 learners have five gaps: collocations and nuance, grammatical complexity, cohesion, accuracy under pressure, and fast natural listening.
scenes.say_uz: B2 dagi besh bo‘shliq: birikmalar va nozik ma’no, grammatik murakkablik, bog‘lanish, bosim ostida aniqlik va tez tabiiy nutqni tushunish.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi bo‘shliq: qotib qolgan xatolar
board: ✗ discuss about · depend from · explain me
✓ discuss · depend on · explain to me
scenes.say_native: Qotib qolgan xato, ya’ni fossilised error — bu yillar davomida takrorlanib, odatga aylangan xato. O‘zbek va rus tilidan ta’sir bilan paydo bo‘ladi. “Muhokama qilmoq” dan “discuss about” chiqadi, lekin to‘g‘risi “discuss” predlogsiz. “Bog‘liq” dan “depend from” chiqadi, to‘g‘risi “depend on”. “Menga tushuntiring” dan “explain me” chiqadi, to‘g‘risi “explain to me”. Ularni xatolar daftariga yozib boring.
scenes.say: We discuss a topic, we depend on something, and we explain something to someone.
scenes.say_uz: Biz mavzuni discuss qilamiz, nimagadir depend on deymiz va kimgadir explain to deymiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: xatoni toping
board: 3. Can you explain me this rule?
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda bitta xato bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri gapni ayting. Birinchi gapda ortiqcha so‘z bor, ikkinchisida noto‘g‘ri predlog, uchinchisida predlog yetishmayapti, to‘rtinchisida ortiqcha fe’l. Gaplarni ovoz chiqarib to‘g‘ri ayting, shunda to‘g‘ri shakl quloqqa o‘rnashadi.
scenes.say: Find and correct the mistake in each of the four sentences.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapning har biridagi xatoni toping va to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: qotgan xatolar
board: 3. Can you explain this rule to me?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “We discussed the budget”, “about” kerak emas. Ikkinchi: “depends on”. Uchinchi: “explain this rule to me”, odam oldidan “to” keladi. To‘rtinchi: “I agree”, “am” ortiqcha, chunki “agree” o‘zi fe’l. Rus tilidagi “я согласен” dan ta’sir bilan bu xato chiqadi. Bu to‘rttasini ayting va yodlab oling.
scenes.say: We discussed the budget. It depends on the weather. Explain this rule to me. I agree with you.
scenes.say_uz: Byudjetni muhokama qildik. Bu ob-havoga bog‘liq. Bu qoidani menga tushuntiring. Men siz bilan roziman.

scenes.title: Uchinchi bo‘shliq: bog‘lovchilar

examples.t: Her sister is outgoing, whereas she is shy.
Prices rose; consequently, fewer people bought cars.
examples.uz: Narxlar oshdi; natijada mashinani kam sotib oldilar.

examples.t: Despite the rain, we went out.

scenes.say_native: B2 da and, but, so bilan cheklanasiz. C1 da bog‘lovchilar fikr yo‘nalishini ko‘rsatadi. “Whereas” ikki narsani qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi. “Consequently” natijani bildiradi. “Although” dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi, “despite” dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli. “That said” — ilgari aytilganga qaramay, boshqa nuqtaga o‘tish. Bu so‘zlar yozma va og‘zaki nutqingizni tartibli qiladi.
scenes.say: Although the plan is cheap, it is risky. Despite the cost, we agreed. That said, I have doubts.
scenes.say_uz: Reja arzon bo‘lsa-da, xavfli. Narxga qaramay, rozi bo‘ldik. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, menda shubha bor.

scenes.title: Mashq: bog‘lovchini tanlang
board: 1. She is shy, ___ her sister is outgoing.
2. Prices rose; ___, fewer people bought cars.
3. ___ the weather was bad, we went out.
4. ___ the bad weather, we went out.
scenes.say_native: Har bir bo‘sh joyga mos bog‘lovchini tanlang: whereas, consequently, although yoki despite. Avval gap ma’nosini o‘ylang: qarama-qarshilikmi, natijami, yoki qaramasdanmi. Keyin “although” yoki “despite” dan keyin nima kelishini tekshiring: gapmi yoki otmi.
scenes.say: Choose from whereas, consequently, although and despite to complete the four sentences.
scenes.say_uz: whereas, consequently, although va despite dan tanlab, to‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: bog‘lovchilar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “whereas”, ikki odamni taqqoslayapmiz. Ikkinchi: “Consequently”, narxlar oshishining natijasi. Uchinchi: “Although the weather was bad”, keyin to‘liq gap bor. To‘rtinchi: “Despite the bad weather”, keyin ot birikmasi kelgan. Ushbu farqni eslab qoling: “despite the weather was bad” deb aytilmaydi.
scenes.say: One: whereas. Two: consequently. Three: although. Four: despite. Despite is followed by a noun phrase.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: whereas. Ikki: consequently. Uch: although. To‘rt: despite. Despite dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi.

scenes.title: O‘qish rejasi: to‘rt ustun
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi reja to‘rt ustunga tayanadi. Birinchi: kunlik kirish, ya’ni o‘qish va tinglash. Ikkinchi: lug‘at daftari, unda so‘z, birikma va misol bor. Uchinchi: haftalik chiqish, ya’ni gapirish va yozish. To‘rtinchi: fikr-mulohaza, ya’ni ovozingizni yozib, tinglash va xatolarni tuzatish. Bittasi yetishmasa, rivojlanish sekinlashadi. Eng ko‘p tashlab qo‘yiladigani to‘rtinchisi.
scenes.say: A good plan has four pillars: input every day, a vocabulary notebook, output every week, and feedback on your own recordings.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi reja to‘rt ustunga tayanadi: kunlik kirish, lug‘at daftari, haftalik chiqish va o‘z yozuvlaringiz bo‘yicha fikr-mulohaza.

scenes.title: Namuna: haftalik jadval
scenes.say_native: Mana kuniga bir soatga yaqin vaqt oladigan haftalik namuna. Dushanba — maqola o‘qish va beshta birikma yozib olish. Chorshanba — podkast tinglash va uni takrorlash, bu shadowing. Juma — besh daqiqalik ovoz yozish. Yakshanba — takrorlash va xatolar daftarini yangilash. Muhimi, jadval real bo‘lsin. Kam, lekin muntazam o‘qish kam-kam, lekin tashlab qo‘yilgan katta rejadan yaxshi.
scenes.say: On Monday I read an article and note five collocations. On Wednesday I shadow a podcast. On Friday I record myself. On Sunday I review my errors.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba maqola o‘qiyman va beshta birikma yozaman. Chorshanba podkastni takrorlayman. Juma o‘zimni yozaman. Yakshanba xatolarni takrorlayman.

scenes.title: Reja tuzishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Learn 50 isolated words in one day
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato bor. Birinchisi: bir kunda ellikta yakka so‘z yodlash. Ular tez unutiladi, chunki kontekst yo‘q. Sakkizta birikmani misol bilan yodlash va takrorlash ancha samarali. Ikkinchisi: faqat grammatika mashqlari qilish. Gapirmasangiz va yozmasangiz, bilim faol bo‘lmaydi. Uchinchisi: o‘zingizni yozib tekshirmaslik. Fikr-mulohazasiz xatolar qotib qoladi.
scenes.say: Learn collocations in context, not isolated words. Balance input and output, and always check your own recordings.
scenes.say_uz: Yakka so‘zlarni emas, kontekstda birikmalarni yodlang. Kirish va chiqishni muvozanatlang, o‘z yozuvlaringizni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Mashq: o‘z haftangizni rejalang
board: On Monday I will ... for ... minutes.
Use: will, going to, by the end of
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z haftangizni rejalang. Yigirma soniya ichida kamida uchta kunni ayting: qaysi kuni nima qilasiz va qancha vaqt. Masalan: “On Monday I will read an article for thirty minutes.” “Will” va “going to” ni ishlating, hamda hammasini real vaqt bilan bog‘lang. Rejangiz ro‘yobga chiqadigan bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Describe your own study week in twenty seconds. Name at least three days, the activity and the time.
scenes.say_uz: Yigirma soniyada o‘z o‘quv haftangizni ayting: kamida uchta kun, mashg‘ulot va vaqt.

scenes.title: Namuna javob: o‘quv rejasi
board: On Monday I will read an article for thirty minutes.
On Wednesday I'm going to shadow a podcast.
By Sunday I will have reviewed my errors.
scenes.say_native: Mana bitta namuna: “On Monday I will read an article for thirty minutes. On Wednesday I’m going to shadow a podcast. By Sunday I will have reviewed my error log.” Ko‘ryapsizmi, rejada aniq kun, aniq vaqt va aniq faoliyat bor. Oxirgi gapda future perfect ishlatildi, bu B2 dan olib kelgan bilimingiz. Sizniki ham shunday aniq bo‘lsa, reja ishlaydi.
scenes.say: On Monday I will read an article for thirty minutes. On Wednesday I'm going to shadow a podcast. By Sunday I will have reviewed my error log.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba o‘ttiz daqiqa maqola o‘qiyman. Chorshanba podkastni takrorlayman. Yakshanbaga qadar xatolar daftarini ko‘rib chiqqan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Lug‘at daftari: qanday yuritiladi
board: Review: next day, after a week, after a month
scenes.say_native: Daftarda har bir yozuvda to‘rtta narsa bo‘lsin. So‘z va uning sheriklari, o‘zingiz tuzgan misol gap, uslub belgisi va takrorlash sanasi. Takrorlashni oraliqlar bilan qiling: ertasiga, bir haftadan, bir oydan keyin. Bu oraliqli takrorlash deyiladi va xotirada mustahkamlaydi. Kechagi so‘zni bugun ishlatishga harakat qiling, shunda u faol lug‘atingizga o‘tadi.
scenes.say: For each new word, record its partners, write your own sentence, note its register, and review it after a day, a week and a month.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir yangi so‘z uchun sheriklarini yozing, o‘z gapingizni tuzing, uslubini belgilang va bir kun, bir hafta, bir oydan keyin takrorlang.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: o‘rtoqlar suhbati
board: Why is A frustrated? What does B suggest?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash matni — ikki do‘st o‘qishdagi yutuq haqida gaplashadi. Eshiting: A nimadan norozi va B qanday yechim taklif qilyapti. Raqamlarga, ya’ni vaqt oraliqlariga ham e’tibor bering, chunki ular haqida savol bo‘ladi. Dialogdan keyin uchta savol beraman, shuning uchun kerak bo‘lsa, yozib boring.
scenes.say: A: Honestly, I feel I've plateaued. I've studied for months, yet I can't see any improvement. B: Have you recorded yourself lately? A: Not really. B: Then try it. Record two minutes now, and again in a month. You'll hear changes you can't feel day to day.
scenes.say_uz: A: Rostini aytsam, o‘sishdan to‘xtaganday his qilyapman. Oylar o‘qidim, lekin yaxshilanishni ko‘rmayapman. B: Yaqinda o‘zingni yozdingmi? A: Unchalik emas. B: Unda sinab ko‘r. Hozir ikki daqiqa yoz, bir oydan keyin yana. Har kuni sezmaydigan o‘zgarishlarni eshitasan.

scenes.title: Mashq: tinglash 2 savollari
board: 3. How long is each recording and when is the next?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Bir: A o‘zini qanday his qilyapti? Ikki: B nima taklif qiladi? Uch: yozuv qancha davom etadi va keyingisi qachon? Javobingizni dialogdagi aniq so‘zlar bilan tasdiqlang. Bu C1 tinglashdagi odat: javobni umumiy taassurotga emas, eshitilgan dalilga tayanib bering.
scenes.say: Answer: how does A feel, what does B suggest, and how long and when are the recordings?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: A qanday his qilyapti, B nima taklif qiladi, yozuv qancha davom etadi va qachon takrorlanadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
board: 1. Frustrated: she feels she has plateaued
3. Two minutes now, and again in a month
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: A hafsalasi pir bo‘lgan, u “plateaued” deydi, ya’ni rivojlanish to‘xtab qolganday. Ikkinchi: B o‘zini ovoz yozishni taklif qiladi. Uchinchi: hozir ikki daqiqa, keyin bir oydan so‘ng yana. Plato bo‘lishi tabiiy hol, C1 da rivojlanish sekin va kichik qadamlarda bo‘ladi, shuning uchun uni o‘lchash muhim.
scenes.say: A feels frustrated. B suggests recording herself: two minutes now and again in a month.
scenes.say_uz: A hafsalasi pir bo‘lgan. B o‘zini yozishni taklif qiladi: hozir ikki daqiqa, bir oydan keyin yana.

scenes.title: Yutuqni qanday o‘lchaymiz
board: Can-do list (tick what you can do)
scenes.say_native: O‘lchash to‘rt vosita bilan oson. Oylik yozuv: bir xil mavzuda gapirib, avvalgisi bilan solishtirasiz. Xatolar daftari: qaysi xato takrorlanmayotganini ko‘rasiz. “Qila olaman” ro‘yxati: masalan, “fikrimni sabab bilan asoslay olaman”. Va vaqt chegaralangan yozma ish: bir xil topshiriqni bir oydan keyin qayta yozasiz. Bular sizga o‘z his-tuyg‘ungizdan ko‘ra ishonchli ma’lumot beradi.
scenes.say: Measure progress with four tools: a monthly recording, an error log, a can-do list and a timed writing task.
scenes.say_uz: Yutuqni to‘rt vosita bilan o‘lchang: oylik yozuv, xatolar daftari, qila olaman ro‘yxati va vaqtli yozma ish.

scenes.title: Xatolar daftari: namuna yozuv
scenes.say_native: Mana xatolar daftarining bir yozuvi. Xatoli gapni, to‘g‘risini, qoidani va shu oy necha marta takrorlanganini yozasiz. Masalan, “discuss about” uch marta uchragan bo‘lsa, maqsad — kelasi oyda nol marta. Bu oddiy hisob sizga qaysi xato eng qimmatga tushayotganini ko‘rsatadi va o‘qishni shu joyga qaratadi. Daftarni haftada bir marta ko‘zdan kechiring.
scenes.say: Write the wrong sentence, the correct one, the rule, and how often it happened. Then set a goal: fewer repeats next month.
scenes.say_uz: Xato gapni, to‘g‘risini, qoidani va qancha takrorlanganini yozing. Keyin maqsad qo‘ying: kelasi oy kamroq takror.

scenes.title: Mashq: C1 maqsadini aniq ayting
board: By the end of C1 I want to be able to ...
scenes.say_native: Endi maqsad qo‘ying. “By the end of C1 I want to be able to...” qolipi bilan bitta aniq va o‘lchanadigan maqsad ayting. Masalan: “By the end of C1 I want to be able to give a five-minute presentation without notes.” “Yaxshi gapirmoqchiman” noaniq, “besh daqiqa qog‘ozsiz” esa o‘lchanadi. Yigirma soniyada ikkita maqsad ayting.
scenes.say: Say two specific, measurable goals using: by the end of C1 I want to be able to.
scenes.say_uz: By the end of C1 I want to be able to qolipi bilan ikkita aniq va o‘lchanadigan maqsad ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna maqsadlar
board: By the end of C1 I want to give a 5-minute talk without notes.
I want to write a 250-word essay in 40 minutes.
I want to understand a news podcast at normal speed.
scenes.say_native: Mana namunalar: “By the end of C1 I want to be able to give a five-minute talk without notes.” “I want to write a two-hundred-and-fifty-word essay in forty minutes.” “I want to follow a news podcast at normal speed.” Har birida natija, o‘lchov va muddat bor. Siz uy vazifasida beshta shunday maqsad yozasiz, hozirgi mashq esa unga tayyorgarlik edi.
scenes.say: I want to give a five-minute talk without notes, write a two-hundred-and-fifty-word essay in forty minutes, and follow a news podcast at normal speed.
scenes.say_uz: Besh daqiqalik nutqni qog‘ozsiz aytmoqchiman, qirq daqiqada 250 so‘zli esse yozmoqchiman va yangiliklar podkastini oddiy tezlikda tushunmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ohang yashirin ma’no beradi
scenes.say_native: Yashirin ma’no ko‘pincha ohangda bo‘ladi. “It’s interesting” gapini ohang pasayishi bilan aytsangiz, bu haqiqiy qiziqish. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang, ya’ni fall-rise bilan aytsangiz, bu shubha va e’tiroz. O‘zbek tilida shubhani ko‘pincha “lekin” so‘zi yoki intonatsiya bilan bildiramiz, inglizchada esa bitta ohang o‘zgarishi butun ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. Shuning uchun tinglovchi sifatida ohangga quloq soling.
scenes.say: The words stay the same, but the tune changes the meaning. A falling tone sounds certain. A fall-rise sounds doubtful.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zlar bir xil, lekin ohang ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. Pasayuvchi ohang ishonchni, pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang shubhani bildiradi.

scenes.title: Mashq: ikki ohangda ayting
scenes.say_native: Gapni ikki marta ayting. Birinchi marta ohang pasayadi va siz chin dildan qiziqasiz. Ikkinchi marta ohang pasayib, so‘ng ko‘tariladi va siz ishonmayotganingizni bildirasiz. “Interesting” so‘zining urg‘ulisi birinchi bo‘g‘in, ya’ni IN-te-res-ting. Ohang o‘zgarishini bo‘rttirib ayting, keyin tabiiyroq qiling.
scenes.say: Say it in two ways: with a falling tone for genuine interest, then with a fall-rise for doubt.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki xil ayting: pasayuvchi ohang bilan chin qiziqish, pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang bilan shubha.

scenes.title: Javob: ohang
scenes.say_native: Eshitib turibman: birinchi variantda ohang tushadi va gap yopiq, tugagan kabi eshitiladi. Ikkinchisida ohang tushib, oxirida biroz ko‘tariladi va gap ochiq qolgandek bo‘ladi, go‘yo “lekin...” deyilmoqchi. Aynan shu ikkinchi ohang ingliz suhbatida mulohazali e’tirozni bildiradi. Endi shuni tinglashda ushlab olishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: A falling tone closes the sentence. A fall-rise leaves it open, as if a but is coming.
scenes.say_uz: Pasayuvchi ohang gapni yopadi. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang uni ochiq qoldiradi, go‘yo lekin keladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: uch daqiqalik nutq
board: 3. Linkers: To begin with, Having said that, All in all
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifangizdagi uch daqiqalik nutq uchun tuzilma kerak. Birinchi: kirish, mavzu va nega muhimligi. Ikkinchi: uchta fikr va har biriga misol. Uchinchi: bog‘lovchilar: “To begin with”, “Having said that”, “All in all”. To‘rtinchi: xulosa va keyingi qadam. Uch daqiqa taxminan to‘rt yuz so‘z degani, ya’ni har bir fikrga bir daqiqa. Yozuvdan oldin faqat tayanch so‘zlar yozing, to‘liq matn emas.
scenes.say: Open with the topic, give three points with examples, link them with signposts, and close with a conclusion and a next step.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu bilan boshlang, misollar bilan uchta fikr keltiring, ularni bog‘lovchilar bilan ulang va xulosa bilan tugating.

scenes.title: Mashq: kirish qismini ayting
board: Today I'd like to talk about ...
scenes.say_native: Kirish qismini mashq qiling. O‘n besh soniyada ayting: “Today I’d like to talk about my plan for reaching C1.” Keyin nega bu muhimligini qo‘shing va birinchi fikrga o‘ting: “To begin with...”. Ishonch bilan, to‘xtamay ayting. Aytganlaringiz keyin uy vazifasidagi yozuvning ochilishi bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Give a fifteen-second opening for your talk: state the topic, say why it matters, and begin your first point with to begin with.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqingiz uchun o‘n besh soniyalik kirish ayting: mavzu, nega muhim va to begin with bilan birinchi fikr.

scenes.title: Namuna: kirish
board: Today I'd like to talk about my plan for reaching C1.
It matters because it will open doors at work and in study.
To begin with, I'll explain my goals.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: “Today I’d like to talk about my plan for reaching C1. It matters because a higher level will open doors at work and in study. To begin with, I’ll explain my main goals.” Ko‘ryapsizmi, uch gap, mavzu, sabab va yo‘l ko‘rsatkich. Bunday ochilish tinglovchiga nima kutishini darrov aytadi va sizni ham tinchlantiradi.
scenes.say: Today I'd like to talk about my plan for reaching C1. It matters because a higher level will open doors at work and in study. To begin with, I'll explain my main goals.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun C1 ga yetish rejam haqida gapirmoqchiman. Bu muhim, chunki yuqori daraja ish va o‘qishda eshiklarni ochadi. Avvalo asosiy maqsadlarimni tushuntiraman.

scenes.title: C1 xaritasi: xulosa
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. C1 uchta kalit bilan belgilanadi: aniqlik, moslashuvchanlik va yashirin ma’no. B2 dagi besh bo‘shliqni bilasiz: birikmalar, grammatik murakkablik, bog‘lanish, qotgan xatolar va tez nutq. Reja to‘rt ustunga tayanadi: kirish, lug‘at, chiqish va fikr-mulohaza. Yutuqni oylik yozuv, xatolar daftari va maqsadlar ro‘yxati bilan o‘lchaysiz. Endi uy vazifasi.
scenes.say: C1 means precision, flexibility and implied meaning. Plan around input, words, output and feedback, and measure with recordings, an error log and clear goals.
scenes.say_uz: C1 aniqlik, moslashuvchanlik va yashirin ma’nodan iborat. Kirish, lug‘at, chiqish va fikr-mulohazaga tayaning, yutuqni yozuv, xatolar daftari va maqsadlar bilan o‘lchang.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi ikki qismdan iborat. Birinchisi: o‘zingizning C1 rejangiz haqida uch daqiqalik nutqni ovozga yozing. Ikkinchisi: beshta C1 maqsadini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutqda kirish, uchta fikr va xulosa bo‘lsin, har bir maqsad esa aniq natija va muddatni o‘z ichiga olsin. Yozuvni saqlab qo‘ying, bir oydan keyin yana yozib, solishtirasiz. Keyingi darsda inversiya va ta’kidlovchi tuzilmalarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Record a three-minute talk about your C1 plan and write five measurable C1 goals. Keep the recording so you can compare it next month.
scenes.say_uz: C1 rejangiz haqida uch daqiqalik nutqni yozing va beshta o‘lchanadigan maqsad yozing. Yozuvni bir oydan keyin solishtirish uchun saqlang.

homework_uz: 1) C1 rejangiz haqida 3 daqiqalik nutqni ovozga yozing: kirish, uchta fikr va xulosa bo‘lsin. 2) 5 ta C1 maqsadini yozing. Mezon: har bir maqsad aniq natija va muddatni o‘z ichiga oladi. Yozuvni bir oydan keyin solishtirish uchun saqlang.

options: The film was very very good.
The film was a big film.
quiz.why_uz: C1 da zaif ‘very good’ o‘rniga aniq so‘z ishlatiladi: gripping.

options: We can't give you the money back.
We are unable to refund your money.

quiz.q: A colleague says: “That’s an interesting idea,” with a fall-rise tone. They probably mean:

options: Can you explain to me this?
Can you explain this to me?

quiz.q: ___ the bad weather, we went out.
quiz.why_uz: Despite dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi.

quiz.q: She is shy, ___ her sister is outgoing.

quiz.why_uz: ‘I am agree’ — qotib qolgan xato; to‘g‘risi ‘I agree’.
